fields.name: North
fields.tagline: Lively towns, beaches and cultural spots.
fields.description: Charming towns, historic landmarks and golden beaches: discover the vibrant spirit of the North
fields.about_text: The North is a captivating blend of heritage, culture and natural beauty. From lush gardens and historic landmarks to vibrant towns and dreamy beaches, the North offers something special for every traveler.
fields.travel_tip: Visit the beaches and Grand Baie early in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the midday heat and crowds, and enjoy the best light for sunsets.

fields.name: South
fields.description: Discover the wild and untouched beauty of southern Mauritius, where dramatic coastline cliffs meet lush green valleys waiting to be explored. From towering waterfalls to hidden beaches, every turn offers a breathtaking new adventure just waiting for you.
fields.about_text:
The south is a land of contrasts and deep history. It carries the legacy of resilience and the struggle for freedom, reflected in places like Le Morne Brabant, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
From spiritual sites and natural wonders to authentic local experiences, the South offers a journey like no other.
fields.travel_tip: The best time to visit the South is from May to December for pleasant weather and calm seas. Don't forget to respect nature and local heritage sites during your visit.

fields.name: East
fields.tagline: Charming villages, beaches and lagoon escapes.
fields.description: The East of Mauritius is a paradise of turquoise lagoons, powdery beaches, lush greenery and vibrant culture — offering the perfect escape for relaxation, adventure and unforgettable memories.
fields.about_text: The East is a blend of natural beauty, cultural heritage and tranquil villages. From idyllic islands and waterfalls to historic temples and lush landscapes, it offers a slower pace of life and authentic Mauritian experiences.
fields.travel_tip:
The best time to explore the East is from May to December for pleasant weather and calmer seas.

Don’t forget your sunscreen, light clothing and a camera to capture the stunning scenery and memories!

fields.name: West
fields.tagline: Sunset views, beaches and adventure experiences.
fields.description: From stunning beaches and turquoise waters to lush mountains and cultural treasures, the West invites you to relax, explore and create unforgettable memories.
fields.about_text: The West is one of Mauritius' most beloved regions, known for its long sandy beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and spectacular sunsets. It is also home to lush nature reserves, charming villages, historical landmarks, and a wide range of activities for every type of traveller.
fields.travel_tip: The best time to explore the West is from May to December for pleasant weather, calm seas and unforgettable sunsets. Don't forget your sunscreen, hat and camera to capture every beautiful moment!
fields.keywords: west tamarin flic en flac sunset

fields.name: Central
fields.tagline: Green heart of the island, rivers, parks and local life.
fields.description: From dormant volcanoes and rolling hills to historical mansions and cascading waterfalls - explore the authentic heart of the Central Mauritius.
fields.about_text:
The Central Region is the cultural and geographic
 part of Mauritius. It is home to volcanic craters, lush forests,
 historic buildings and lively towns. 
From breathtaking viewpoints to serene  natural spots, 
the Central offers a perfect mix of heritage, 
adventure and relaxation.
fields.travel_tip:
The best time to explore the Central is from May to December for cooler weather and clear skies.

Wear comfortable shoes for hikes, carry water and don't forget your camera for unforgettable views!

fields.name: Grand Bassin
fields.short_description: Serene holy waters
fields.description: Experience the tranquil beauty and spiritual heart of Mauritius at Grand Bassin, home to a sacred crater lake surrounded by majestic temples and giant statues. Wander through serene shores, feel the peaceful atmosphere, and discover the rich culture and stunning landscapes waiting in every direction.

fields.name: La Vanille Nature Park
fields.short_description: Vibrant animal paradise
fields.description: Step into a lush tropical oasis, where you can walk alongside giant Aldabra tortoises. From vibrant insectariums to interactive feeding sessions, it offers an unforgettable adventure for nature lovers of all ages.

fields.name: Seven Coloured Earths
fields.short_description: Vibrant volcanic sands
fields.description: Discover mesmerising dunes where volcanic sands naturally split into vibrant shades of red, violet, green, and blue. Stroll along sunny trails, pause by a majestic nearby waterfall, and marvel at one of the island's most unique natural wonders.

fields.name: Frederica Nature Reserve
fields.short_description: Wild, untouched sanctuary
fields.description: Step into the breathtaking sanctuaries of Frederica Nature Reserve, where tranquil waterfalls, rare wildlife, and lush valleys create an unforgettable escape. Whether you are seeking high-energy quad biking adventures or peaceful nature walks, every path unveils a captivating new piece of island paradise.

fields.name: Marine Park
fields.short_description: Protected vibrant coral haven.
fields.description: Blue Bay Marine Park is a premier protected aquatic sanctuary off the southeast coast of Mauritius, renowned for its crystal-clear turquoise lagoon and thriving underwater ecosystems. Visitors can immerse themselves in a vibrant marine world home to over 50 species of colorful corals, rare sea turtles, and rich tropical fish life.

fields.name: Macconde Viewpoint
fields.short_description: Dramatic cliffside hairpin views.
fields.description: Macondé Viewpoint is a famous scenic lookout set along a dramatic coastal cliff side in southwestern Mauritius. Perched directly above a sharp hairpin bend in the road, it climbs up a rocky outcrop to deliver breathtaking, panoramic views of the turquoise ocean and rugged coastline.

fields.name: Blue Bay
fields.short_description: Crystal-clear tropical marine paradise.
fields.description: Blue Bay is one of Mauritius's most celebrated coastal destinations, famous for its powder-soft white sand beaches and sheltered, turquoise lagoon. Serving as the gateway to a renowned marine sanctuary, it offers a peaceful tropical escape ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and effortless aquatic exploration.
